senses.gloss: रुणस्वरा f. (-रा) A cow easily milked.

रुण्ड m. (-ण्डः)
 1. A headless body, retaining life and mixing in combat.
“कवन्धे”.
 2. A trunk.
 E. रुडि for रुटि or रुठि to take or steal, aff. अच् ।

रुण्डिका f. (-का)
 1. The threshold of a door.
 2. A field of battle.
 3. A
female messenger or go-between.
 4. Superhuman power.
 E. रुण्ड as
above, कन् aff., fem. form.
